content: Nabbed tickets for South Pacific in June at Bucks County Playhouse—a venue that I *just learned* was where Neil Simon premiered Barefoot in the Park with Robert Redford and Elizabeth Ashley. Am I thrilled to see a show I haven’t seen since high school, in a building that was constructed as a mill in 1790, in a town that was the site of Washington crossing the Delaware in 1776? Obviously I’m *ecstatic*
